title: core
text:
一、Dialog 查询与导航







函数
用途




await curr_dialog(with_messages=False, dname='') -> dict \| str
获取当前 dialog 信息


await view_dlg(dname='', msg_type=None, nums=False, include_output=False, trunc_out=True, trunc_in=False, include_skipped=False) -> str
整 dialog 的简洁 XML 概览（推荐优先使用）


await find_msgs(re_pattern='', msg_type=None, before=0, after=0, context=0, use_case=False, use_regex=True, only_err=False, only_exp=False, only_chg=False, ids='', limit=None, include_output=True, include_meta=True, as_xml=False, nums=False, trunc_out=False, trunc_in=False, headers_only=False, header_section=None, include_skipped=False, dname='') -> list[dict]
正则搜索消息；as_xml=True 可获简洁格式


await read_msg(n=-1, relative=True, id=None, view_range=None, nums=False, dname='') -> dict
按相对/绝对位置读一条消息；n=0+id=精确定位


await view_msg(id, dname='', nums=True, view_range=None, add_to_dlg=False) -> str
只看消息 content（带行号）


await read_msgid(id, view_range=None, nums=False, dname='', add_to_dlg=False) -> dict
按 id 读取含元数据与输出的完整消息


await msg_idx(id=None, dname='') -> int
消息在 dialog 中的绝对索引


await list_dialogs(subpath='', depth=1) -> dict
列出子路径下的 dialog 和文件夹（文件夹以 / 结尾）


await realpath(subpath='/') -> str
获取 solveit 子路径的磁盘真实路径


await dialog_link(dname='', msg_id=None) -> HTML
生成打开 dialog 的可点击链接；直接输出返回的 <a> 标签


await names_containing(s: str)
查找 IPython 命名空间中包含 s 的名字


await find_dname(dname=None, required=True)
解析 dialog 名称（从调用栈或显式提供）

title: core
text:
二、消息编辑

编辑工作流

先用 await view_msg(id) 获知当前内容和行号
选用下方编辑函数
所有编辑函数均支持 id 为 str（单条）、list[str]（多条）或 'all'（全 dialog）
update_output=True 可编辑输出而非 content
返回值：单 id → diff 字符串；多 id → [(id, diff), ...]



字符串替换
await msg_str_replace(id, old_str, new_str, start_line=None, end_line=None,
    n_matches=None, re_filter=None, invert_filter=False, *,
    update_output=False, dname='', log_changed=False)
精确替换 old_str → new_str。n_matches 限制次数；re_filter 只作用于匹配该正则的行。
await msg_strs_replace(id, old_strs: list[str], new_strs: list[str], ...)
同时替换多对字符串，一次调用完成。


行级编辑
await msg_replace_lines(id, start_line, end_line=None, new_content='', ...)
await msg_del_lines(id, start_line, end_line=None, re_filter=None, invert_filter=False, ...)
await msg_insert_line(id, insert_line, new_str, ...)


Exhash（hash 验证行编辑器）
await msg_lnhashview(id, dname='') -> str
获取 lineno|hash|content 格式的带地址行。
await msg_exhash(id, cmds: list, dname='') -> str
按 hash 地址执行 ex 风格命令，hash 在每条命令执行前校验。
地址格式： 12|a3f2|cmd（单行）或 12|a3f2|,15|b1c3|cmd（范围），0|0000| 只能配合 a/i。
命令： - s/pat/rep/[flags] — 替换（g=全局, i=忽略大小写） - d — 删除 - a / i / c — 追加 / 插入 / 替换（文本紧跟命令后换行，无需 . 结束符） - j — 合并行 - m dest / t dest — 移动 / 复制到目标地址后 - >[n] / <[n] — 缩进 / 反缩进（默认 4 空格） - sort — 排序 - p — 打印（不修改） - g/pat/cmd / g!/pat/cmd — 全局匹配行执行命令
关键规则： 多条命令从后往前执行（防行号偏移），必须使用 msg_lnhashview 获取地址后立刻编辑。


Python 编辑
await msg_python(id, code, ...)
用 Python 代码编辑消息内容，text 变量保存当前 content，最后一个表达式为新 content。

title: core
text:
三、消息增删
await add_msg(content, msg_type='note', run=False, *,
    placement='', id=None, dname='', wait=False, poll=0.5,
    output='', time_run='', is_exported=0, skipped=0,
    i_collapsed=0, o_collapsed=0, heading_collapsed=0, pinned=0) -> str
添加消息，返回新消息 id。placement: add_after/add_before(相对) 或 at_start/at_end(绝对)。 连续添加时，必须将上一次返回的 id 传给下一次的 id，否则顺序反转。
await update_msg(id=None, msg=None, dname='', log_changed=False, *,
    content=None, msg_type=None, output=None, time_run=None,
    is_exported=None, skipped=None, i_collapsed=None,
    o_collapsed=None, heading_collapsed=None, pinned=None) -> str
部分更新消息，只传要改的字段。
await del_msg(id=None, dname='', log_changed=False) -> dict
删除消息。非明确要求不得使用。
await copy_msg(ids=None, cut=False, dname='') -> dict
await paste_msg(id=None, after=True, dname='') -> dict
剪切板复制/粘贴，用于在运行中的 dialog 内移动/复制消息。

title: core
text:
四、Dialog 生命周期
await create_or_run_dialog(name, template=True)
await stop_dialog(name)
await rm_dialog(name)                  # 删除 dialog 或文件夹，停止内核
await load_dialog(src_dname, dname='') # 将 src_dname 的所有 code 注入目标 kernel 并返回内容

title: core
text:
五、运行与交互
await run_msg(ids=None, dname='')                     # 将消息加入运行队列
await run_code_interactive(code)                      # 插入代码并请求用户运行（终端工具，调用后停止所有工具使用）
await run_and_prompt(code, prompt='Continue.') -> str # 运行 code 再运行 prompt

title: core
text:
六、HTML / JS / Mermaid
await add_html(content, dname='')    # 发送 HTML 到浏览器 DOM
await add_mod(s)                      # 将 JS 代码包裹为 `<script type="module">`
await add_scr(scr, oob='innerHTML:#ephemeral')  # 交换 script 元素到 ephemeral
await iife(code)                      # IIFE 包裹 JS 代码并执行
await js_eval(expr) -> Any           # 在浏览器中 eval JS 表达式，返回结果
await js_run(code)                    # 运行 JS 代码，代码中调用 `done()` 后返回结果
await enable_mermaid()
await mermaid(code, cls='mermaid', **kwargs)  # 渲染 Mermaid 图
(_a 后缀版本为异步变体)

title: core
text:
七、事件系统
await fire_event(evt, **data)                      # 触发浏览器事件
await event_get(evt, timeout=15, **data)           # 触发事件 + 等待结果
await event_once(evt, timeout=15, ttl=5000, **data) # 同上 + 防重放
await trigger_now(evt, data=None, ttl=5000)         # 同步触发，防重放
await pop_data(idx, timeout=15)                     # 按索引取出数据
(_a 后缀为异步变体)

title: core
text:
八、端点调用
await call_endp(path, dname='', json=False, raiseex=False,
    id=None, required=True, timeout=10, audit=False, **data)
调用 solveit HTTP 端点。_a 变体同理。

title: core
text:
九、HTTP 请求
await xgeta(url, **kwargs)   # GET 请求
await xposta(url, **kwargs)  # POST 请求

title: core
text:
十、网络搜索与 URL
await search(q)                        # 搜索查询（通常用 web_answer 代替）
await searches(queries: list[str])     # 并行多查询
await web_answer(pr, qs: list[str], page_chars=50000)  # 搜索代理：搜多查询 + 读页面 + 回答
await url2note(url, extract_section=True, selector=None, ai_img=True, split_re='')  # URL → markdown → 添加为 note

title: core
text:
十一、Agent
await spawn_agent(prompt)  # 派生子 agent 执行任务；上下文和工具继承自父 prompt

title: core
text:
十二、其他
await display_response(display, result=None)
    # display → 渲染给用户看的 markdown/HTML
    # result → 返回给 LLM 的文本

await allow(*c, allow_policy=None)
    # 将 c 中的项加入 __pytools__，可选约束策略

await solveit_docs()
    # 返回 Solveit 完整参考文档（每次重新运行，不要缓存）

msg_ref(id: str, dname='') -> str
    # 生成消息引用链接：同 dialog 用 `#id`，跨 dialog 用 `#dname/id`

Placements                         # 放置位置常量
connfiles                          # 连接文件配置
dh_settings                        # dialoghelper 设置
realpath(subpath='/') -> str       # 获取 solveit 子路径的磁盘路径

title: core
text:
概述
nbdev 是一个 笔记本驱动的开发平台。在 Jupyter Notebook 中编写代码、测试和文档，自动获得：

Quarto 文档：自动生成，支持 LaTeX、搜索、超链接（含跨包 doclinks，通过 nbdev-index）
Python 打包：发布到 PyPI 和 conda，自动管理 __all__
双向同步：notebook ↔︎ .py 模块，每个导出 cell 带有唯一 cell ID
并行测试：nbdev-test 并行运行所有 notebook 中的测试 cell
CI 开箱即用：GitHub Actions 自动测试和部署文档
Git 友好：自动清理元数据、人类可读的合并冲突

title: core
text:
安装
pip install nbdev
# 还需要 Quarto:
nbdev-install-quarto
仅支持 macOS / Linux / WSL。必须与 Jupyter 在同一 Python 环境。

title: core
text:
项目结构
myproject/
├── pyproject.toml          # 项目配置（nbdev3：不再使用 settings.ini）
├── nbs/                    # 笔记本源码
│   ├── index.ipynb         # README + 文档首页
│   ├── 00_core.ipynb       # 核心模块
│   └── ...
├── myproject/              # 导出的 Python 包（由 nbdev-export 生成）
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── core.py
│   └── ...
├── _docs/                  # 生成的文档（由 nbdev-docs / Quarto 生成）
├── .github/workflows/      # CI 工作流
└── README.md               # 由 index.ipynb 自动生成

title: core
text:
快速开始
# 1. 创建 GitHub 空仓库，clone 到本地
git clone https://github.com/you/myrepo
cd myrepo

# 2. 初始化 nbdev 项目（推断 git/GitHub 信息）
nbdev-new

# 3. 安装 git hooks（每次保存自动清理 notebook 元数据）
nbdev-install-hooks

# 4. 安装开发模式包
pip install -e '.[dev]'

# 5. 编辑 nbs/00_core.ipynb，然后导出 + 测试 + 清理
nbdev-prepare

# 6. 预览文档
nbdev-preview

# 7. 提交并推送
git add . && git commit -m 'Initial' && git push

title: core
text:
pyproject.toml 配置
[project]
name = "myproject"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "A short summary"
authors = [{ name = "Your Name", email = "you@example.com" }]
dependencies = ["fastcore>=1.0.5"]
requires-python = ">=3.10"
license = { text = "Apache-2.0" }

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = ["nbdev", "jupyterlab"]

[tool.nbdev]
lib_name = "myproject"          # 包名（- → _）
lib_path = "myproject"          # 包路径
nbs_path = "nbs"                # notebook 目录
doc_path = "_docs"              # 文档输出目录
tst_flags = "notest"            # 测试时跳过的 cell 标记
req_flags = ""                  # 需要的外部依赖标记
get_config() 返回 ConfigToml 对象（AttrDict），可通过属性访问所有键。

title: core
text:
指令（Directives）
指令是 #| 开头的特殊注释，控制 cell 的可见性、导出行为和执行。

可见性







指令
效果




#\| hide (📓)
隐藏整个 cell（输入+输出）。等同 Quarto 的 #\| include: false


#\| echo: false (🔵)
隐藏输入，只显示输出


#\| output: false (🔵)
隐藏输出


#\| output: asis (🔵)
将输出作为原始 markdown 渲染


#\| hide_line (📓)
在行末使用，隐藏该行代码


#\| filter_stream <keyword> (📓)
从输出中过滤包含指定关键词的行


#\| code-fold: true (🔵)
折叠代码（true=默认折叠，show=默认展开）





导出







指令
效果




#\| default_exp <module>
设置默认导出模块名


#\| export
导出到模块 + 文档。自动加入 __all__


#\| exporti
内部导出：导出到模块但不加入 __all__ 和文档。等价于 _ 前缀命名


#\| exports
同 export，但额外显示源码





执行



指令
效果




#\| exec_doc (📓)
每次生成文档时重新执行此 cell


#\| eval: false (🔵)
测试时跳过此 cell

title: core
text:
开发工作流

1. 写 Notebook
每个 notebook 顶部有 markdown frontmatter：
# 页面标题

> 页面描述/副标题
#| default_exp core

导出函数/类用 #| export
导出但不公开用 #| exporti 或下划线前缀
在导出 cell 后紧跟测试/示例 cell（用 assert 或 fastcore.test）
每个 notebook 底部建议加 #| hide; import nbdev; nbdev.nbdev_export()



2. 文档化

docments：类型注解 + 行末注释即可自动生成参数表

def foo(x:int,            # X 轴坐标
        y:int=0           # Y 轴坐标，默认 0
        ) -> str:         # 返回的字符串
    "简短的一句话说明"

show_doc(sym)：在 notebook 中显示任意符号的文档（用于方法文档化）
doclinks：用反引号包围符号名自动生成链接，如 `myproject.core.foo`
类方法文档化两种方式：show_doc(ClassName.method) 或 @patch 装饰器



3. 导出
nbdev-export          # 导出所有 notebook → .py 模块
nb-export nb.ipynb    # 导出单个 notebook


4. 测试
nbdev-test                          # 测试所有
nbdev-test --path nbs/00_core.ipynb # 测试单个
nbdev-test --flags "notest"         # 强制运行被标记跳过的 cell
nbdev-test --n_workers 0            # 单线程（调试用）
tst_flags 在 pyproject.toml 中配置，测试时跳过包含这些标记的 cell。test_nb() 返回 (success:bool, duration:float)。


5. 清理
nbdev-clean    # 剥离多余元数据，避免 git 合并冲突


6. 双向同步
nbdev-update              # .py 中的小修改 → 回传到 notebook
nbdev-update core.py      # 只更新指定模块
限制：不能新建/重排 cell，仅限已有 cell 内的修改。需要 .py 中有 # %% path/nb.ipynb #cell_id 标记。


7. 发布
nbdev-pypi          # 发布到 PyPI
nbdev-conda         # 发布到 conda
nbdev-release-both  # 同时发布到两者
nbdev-release-gh    # changelog + git tag + GitHub release

title: core
text:
API 参考

nbdev.config — 配置

get_config(path=None) → ConfigToml：从当前目录向上查找 pyproject.toml（含 [tool.nbdev]）
ConfigToml：AttrDict 子类，. 访问键。属性：lib_name, lib_path, nbs_path, doc_path, config_path, config_file, version
is_nbdev(path=None) → bool：是否在 nbdev 项目中
nbdev_create_config(repo, branch, user, ...)：CLI 创建 pyproject.toml
read_version(path) / set_version(path, version)：读写 __version__
bump_version(v, part=2)：part=0(major)/1(minor)/2(patch)
update_version(path) / update_proj(path) / add_init(path)
import_obj(s)：导入 "module:obj" 字符串
write_cells(cells, hdr, file)：内部 bootstrap 导出



nbdev.export — 导出

nb_export(nbname, lib_path=None, procs=None, name=None, mod_maker=ModuleMaker, debug=False, solo_nb=False)：从 notebook 创建模块
ExportModuleProc：NBProcessor 的处理器，收集导出 cell 到 modules dict



nbdev.maker — 模块生成

ModuleMaker(dest, name, nb_path, is_new, parse, solo_nb)：从 notebook cell 创建导出库
ModuleMaker.make(cells, all_cells, lib_path)：写入模块和 __all__
ModuleMaker.make_all(cells)：从导出 cell 生成 __all__
find_var(lines, varname) / read_var(code, varname) / update_var(varname, func, fn, code)
relative_import(name, fname, level)



nbdev.process — 笔记本处理

NBProcessor(path, procs, nb, debug=False, rm_directives=True, process=True)：核心处理器，按顺序应用 Processor 列表

process()：遍历所有 cell，对每个 cell 依次调用每个 processor

Processor(nb)：基类。方法：cell(cell)、__call__(cell)
extract_directives(cell, remove=True)：提取 #| 指令为 dict



nbdev.processors — 内置处理器

FilterDefaults：定义导出和文档所用的处理器链。可继承覆盖 procs(), base_procs(), xtra_procs()

nb_proc(nb) → NBProcessor
FilterDefaults.procs() → 完整处理器列表

populate_language：设置 cell 语言
insert_warning：插入「AUTOGENERATED」警告
add_show_docs：在导出 cell 后自动添加 show_doc
mv_exports：移动 exports cell 到 show_doc 之后
exec_show_docs：执行 imports + exports + show_doc 以生成文档
add_links：转换 markdown cell 中的 doclinks
add_fold：给 exports cell 添加 code-fold
strip_hidden_metadata / hide_ / hide_line / filter_stream_
ai_magics / clean_magics / rm_header_dash / rm_export / clean_show_doc
fdiv(attrs) / boxify(cells)：Quarto 标记辅助



nbdev.showdoc — 文档渲染

show_doc(sym, renderer=None, name=None, title_level=3)：渲染符号的签名 + docstring 为 markdown
BasicMarkdownRenderer(sym, name=None, title_level=3, maxline=110)：默认 markdown 渲染器
doc(elt)：显示 show_doc 信息 + 文档链接
showdoc_nm(tree)：获取完全限定名
colab_link(path)：生成 Colab 链接



nbdev.doclinks — 文档链接

NbdevLookup(strip_libs, incl_libs, skip_mods, ns)：将符号名映射到 docs/source URL

doc(sym) / code(sym) → URL
linkify(md) → 把 markdown 中的反引号符号替换为链接

nbglob(path, ...)：根据配置查找文件
nbdev_export(path, procs, ...)：批量导出
create_index(url, pre)：从 sphinx inventory 创建文档索引



nbdev.sync — 双向同步

nbdev_update(fname=None)：将 .py 模块修改回传到 notebook
absolute_import(name, fname, level)：解析相对导入



nbdev.merge — 合并冲突

nbdev_merge(base, ours, theirs, path)：Git merge 驱动
nbdev_fix(nbname, outname=None, nobackup=False, theirs=False)：从冲突 notebook 创建可用版本
unpatch(s)：提取冲突标记中的原始文件



nbdev.clean — 清理

nbdev_clean(fname, clear_all=False)：清理 notebook 元数据
clean_nb(nb, ...)：底层清理函数

title: core
text:
测试
nbdev 将测试视为一等公民。每个 notebook 代码 cell 都会被 nbdev-test 执行。

使用 assert 或 fastcore.test（test_eq, test_is, test_fail 等）
跳过测试：#| eval: false 或 tst_flags 中配置的标记（如 notest）
test_fail(lambda: fn(), contains="error msg") 用于文档化错误场景
nbdev-test --flags "notest" 强制运行标记的 cell

title: core
text:
最佳实践摘要

短 docstring：一行总结即可，细节放在 prose cell + 代码示例中
docments：类型注解 + 行末注释 → 自动参数表
cell 短小：拆分长函数，用 @patch 分散方法定义
立即演示：代码 cell 后紧跟示例/测试 cell
测试即文档：示例 cell 加 assert，既是文档也是测试
doclinks：反引号符号名自动超链接
_repr_markdown_：给类添加富文本表示
H2 分组：markdown ## 分组相关符号；#### 子分组详细说明
show_doc 文档化方法：类定义在同一 cell 时用 show_doc(Method)；拆分 cell 时用 @patch
错误文档化：test_fail 优于 docstring 中的 “raises” 段落
autoreload：notebook 顶部 %load_ext autoreload; %autoreload 2

title: core
text:
注意事项

不要在同一个 cell 中混合 import 和其他代码（会导致文档生成时的副作用）
修改 default_exp 后记得删除旧的 .py 模块（nbdev 不会自动清理）
Windows 仅支持 WSL
导出的 .py 包含 cell ID 标记：# %% path/nb.ipynb #cell_id

text:
Core Types (fastllm.types)
All types are dataclasses.

Part — Canonical Atomic Content Unit
@dataclass
class Part:
    type: str       # semantic modality
    text: str = None
    data: dict = None









Canonical type

Msg
@dataclass
class Msg:
    role: str              # user | assistant | tool
    content: List[Part]
Quick helper: user(text) → Msg(role='user', content=[Part(type='text', text=text)])


ToolCall
@dataclass
class ToolCall:
    id: str
    name: str
    arguments: dict = {}
    server: bool = False       # True for web_search, code_exec, etc.
    extra: dict = {}


Usage
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Usage:
    prompt_tokens: int = 0
    completion_tokens: int = 0
    total_tokens: int = 0
    cached_tokens: int = 0
    cache_creation_tokens: int = 0
    reasoning_tokens: int = 0
    raw: dict = {}


Completion
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Completion:
    model: str
    message: Msg
    finish_reason: str = None     # stop | tool_calls | length | content_filter
    usage: Usage = None
    tool_calls: List[ToolCall] = []
    api_name: str = None
    vendor_name: str = None
    raw: dict = {}
Has .cost property computed from raw usage + registered cost function.


Key Helpers
mk_completion(resp, model, api_name, vendor_name) → Completion
mk_tool_res_msg(tool_calls, results) → Msg
fn_schema(t) → (name, description, parameters)
sys_text(system) → str
get_model_pricing(model, vendor_name) → dict (per-million costs)
approx_pricing(model, vendor_name, out=10, cache=80, inp=10) → float
infer_api_name(model) → 'anthropic'|'gemini'|'openai'

title: core
text:
Streaming (fastllm.streaming)

Delta — Streaming Event
@dataclass
class Delta:
    text: str = ""
    thinking: str = ""
    refusal: str = ""
    tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
    citations: list = []
    server_tool_result: dict = None
    finish_reason: str = None
    usage: Usage = None
    raw: dict = {}


PartAccum — Stream Collator
part_accum = PartAccum()
part_accum.append('text', idx, txt)
part_accum.append('tool_use', idx, id=..., name=..., arguments=...)
parts, tool_calls = part_accum.get_merged()


mk_acollect_stream(it, index_fn, ...)
Core streaming pipeline. Takes async iterable of Delta, yields: - {"text": "..."} — text chunks - {"thinking": "..."} — reasoning chunks - {"citations": [...]} — citation events - Part(type="tool_use", data={...}) — ready tool calls - {"thinking": "processing"} — fence-stop processing - Final Completion


Stop Callables
stop_sequences(seqs) → callable   # stop on any sequence match
FenceToolStop({'py', 'bash'})     # stop on `````py/`````bash fence blocks

title: core
text:
acomplete (main entry, fastllm.acomplete)
async acomplete(
    msgs: list[Msg],
    model: str = None,
    stream: bool = False,
    system = None,              # str or Part
    max_tokens: int = None,
    temperature: float = None,
    tools: list = None,
    tool_choice = None,         # 'auto'|'required'|'none'|'tool_name'
    reasoning_effort = None,    # 'low'|'medium'|'high'|dict
    web_search_options: dict = None,
    stop_callables: list = None,
    api_key: str = None,
    api_name: str = None,
    vendor_name: str = None,
    client: OpenAPIClient = None
)
Non-stream: returns Completion. Stream: returns async iterable.
Vendor name: infer_api_name(model) → anthropic/gemini/openai. API key: parameter → env var (OPENAI_API_KEY/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY/GEMINI_API_KEY) → model metadata.

title: core
text:
Usage Examples

Basic
msgs = [Msg('user', [Part('text', 'Capital of France?')])]
r = await acomplete(msgs, model='gpt-4o-mini')


Streaming
async for o in await acomplete(msgs, model='claude-sonnet-4-6', stream=True):
    if isinstance(o, Completion): final = o
    elif t:=o.get('text'): print(t, end='')


Tools
r1 = await acomplete(msgs, tools=tools, model='gpt-4o-mini')
msgs += [r1.message, mk_tool_res_msg(r1.tool_calls, ['22°C'])]
r2 = await acomplete(msgs, tools=tools, model='gpt-4o-mini')


Cross-provider
r1 = await acomplete(msgs, model='claude-sonnet-4-6')
msgs += [r1.message, user('more info?')]
r2 = await acomplete(msgs, model='models/gemini-3-flash-preview')


System prompt
r = await acomplete(msgs, system="You are a pirate.", model='gpt-4o-mini')


Images
img_msg = Msg('user', [
    Part('input_image', 'https://example.com/photo.jpg'),
    Part('text', "What's in this image?")
])


Web Search
# OpenAI
r = await acomplete(msgs, model='gpt-4o-mini',
                    tools=[{"type": "web_search_preview"}])
# Anthropic
r = await acomplete(msgs, model='claude-sonnet-4-6',
                    web_search_options={})
# Gemini
r = await acomplete(msgs, model='models/gemini-3-flash-preview',
                    web_search_options={})


Caching (Anthropic)
system = Part('text', long_text, data={'cache_control': {'type': 'ephemeral'}})

title: core
text:
Architecture
Msg[] + model + kwargs
        │
   acomplete()
        │
        ├─ infer api_name/vendor_name
        ├─ mk_payload(msgs, model, ...) → provider dict
        ├─ call op (stream or non-stream)
        │
   ┌─ non-stream: resp → mk_completion(norm_*) → Completion
   └─ stream: resp → norm_sse_event → mk_acollect_stream → Completion
Escape hatch: Part.data["<provider>"] / Msg.data["<provider>"] bypasses canonicalization.

title: core
text:
一、安装
pip install fastlite

title: core
text:
二、连接数据库
from fastlite import *

db = database("chinook.sqlite")  # 持久化文件
# 或
db = database(":memory:")         # 内存数据库
database() 是 fastlite 封装的工厂函数，不是 sqlite-utils 的 Database（apswutils 已改为 APSW 后端、WAL 默认）。
Database 对象也有以下构造方式：
db = Database("data.db")                              # 文件路径
db = Database("data.db", recreate=True)               # 重建
db = Database(memory=True)                            # 内存

title: core
text:
三、核心属性

db.t — 表访问（自动补全）
dt = db.t
dt              # 列出所有表名
dt.Artist        # 单表 -> <Table Artist (ArtistId, Name)>
dt['Artist','Album']  # 多表 -> list[Table]
'Artist' in dt  # True


table.c — 列访问（自动补全）
artist = dt.Artist
ac = artist.c
ac              # ArtistId, Name
ac.Name         # -> "Artist"."Name" (可直接用于 SQL f-string)

f"select * from {artist} where {ac.Name} like 'AC/%'"
# => select * from "Artist" where "Artist"."Name" like 'AC/%'


db.v — 视图访问
db.create_view("AccaDaccaAlbums", acca_sql, replace=True)
db.v.AccaDaccaAlbums()  # 查询视图

title: core
text:
四、查询

db.q(sql) — 快速查询
db.q(f"select * from {artist} where {ac.Name} like 'AC/%'")
# => [{'ArtistId': 1, 'Name': 'AC/DC'}]


table(…) — 调用表查询
调用 dataclass() 之后自动返回 dataclass 对象：
album.dataclass()
album(limit=2)       # 返回 list[Album]
album(with_pk=1, limit=2)  # [(pk, Album), ...]
album[1]              # 按主键索引 -> Album(...)
参数：where / where_args / order_by / limit / offset / select / with_pk / as_cls / xtra


table.selectone(…)
artist.selectone('Name=?', ('AC/DC',))
# => Artist(...)  返回唯一一条，否则 NotFoundError 或 ValueError

title: core
text:
五、数据类（Dataclass）

table.dataclass()
Album = album.dataclass()
Album(AlbumId=1, Title='For Those...', ArtistId=1)


create_mod — 导出到模块
create_mod(db, 'db_dc')
# 写入 db_dc.py 文件
from db_dc import Track
Track()  # 全默认值


all_dcs / link_dcs
all_dcs(db)    # 所有表的 dataclass 列表
db.set_classes(globals())
db.get_tables(globals())  # 将表对象注入全局命名空间

title: core
text:
六、创建表

db.create(cls, …) — 从类创建
class Cat: id: int; name: str; weight: float
cats = db.create(Cat)
可选参数：pk='id'（主键，单列 str 或复合 tuple）、transform=True、foreign_keys=[...]、defaults={'col': val}、not_null={'col1','col2'}、strict=True


table.create(columns, …) — 显式列定义
cats.create(id=int, name=str, weight=float, pk='id')
# => CREATE TABLE [cats] (
#      [id] INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
#      [name] TEXT,
#      [weight] FLOAT
#    )


db.import_file — 从 CSV/TSV 等导入
table = db.import_file("people", csv_data)   # 也接受文件路径、bytes、file handle
table = db.import_file("people", csv3, alter=True)  # 自动加新列

title: core
text:
七、数据操作
所有方法接受 dict / dataclass / 普通 class / kwargs，返回更新后的记录。

insert / insert_all
cats.insert({'name': 'Rex', 'weight': 12.2})  # dict
cats.insert(CatDC(name='Tom', weight=10.2))   # dataclass
cats.insert(Cat(name='Jerry', weight=5.2))    # class
cats.insert(name='Kitty', weight=3)           # kwargs

cats.insert_all([{'name': 'A'}, {'name': 'B'}], batch_size=100)
# 参数: alter=True, ignore=True, replace=True, pk=...


update
cats.update(dict(id=1, name='Jerry', weight=6.2))  # dict
cats.update(CatDC(id=1, name='Jerry', weight=6.3)) # dataclass
cats.update(Cat(id=1, name='Jerry', weight=5.7))   # class
cats.update(id=1, name='Jerry', weight=5.7)        # kwargs


upsert / upsert_all
存在则更新，不存在则插入。必须包含主键值。


delete
cats.delete(1)                   # 单主键
petfoods.delete((1, 'tuna'))     # 复合主键

title: core
text:
八、xtra — 行级过滤
album.xtra(ArtistId=1)
album()        # 只返回 ArtistId=1 的行

cats.xtra(uid=2)
cats.insert(name='meow', weight=6)  # 自动带上 uid=2
# 返回 {'id': 1, 'name': 'meow', 'weight': 6.0, 'uid': 2}

cats.xtra(uid=1)
cats.update(**cat)   # NotFoundError（uid 不匹配）

title: core
text:
九、多字段主键
class PetFood: catid: int; food: str; qty: int
petfoods = db.create(PetFood, pk=['catid', 'food'])

petfoods[1, 'tuna']     # 索引
petfoods.delete((1, 'tuna'))  # 删除
pf.qty=3; petfoods.update(pf)
pf.qty=1; petfoods.upsert(pf)

title: core
text:
十、表结构修改

add_column
table.add_column("instagram", str)
table.add_column("weight", float)
table.add_column("species_id", fk="species")  # 外键


transform — 完整变换
table.transform(
    types={'age': int},              # 改类型
    rename={'age': 'initial_age'},   # 重命名
    drop={'old_col'},                # 删列
    pk='new_id',                     # 换主键
    not_null={'age', 'weight'},      # 改 NOT NULL
    defaults={'age': 1},             # 改默认值
    column_order=('name', 'age', 'id'),
    add_foreign_keys=(('country', 'country', 'id'),),
    drop_foreign_keys=('country',),
    strict=True,
)


drop / rename
table.drop(ignore=True)
db.rename_table("old", "new")

title: core
text:
十一、数据库图
diagram(db.t['Artist','Album','Track','Genre','MediaType'], size=8, ratio=0.4)
需要 graphviz。

title: core
text:
十二、事务
with db.atomic():  # 推荐
    db.table("accounts").update(1, {"balance": 90})
    db.table("accounts").update(2, {"balance": 110})

# 手动:
db.begin()
db.commit() / db.rollback()

title: core
text:
十三、全文本搜索（FTS）
table.enable_fts(["name", "twitter"], create_triggers=True)
table.search("cleo")          # order_by, limit, where, columns, include_rank
table.populate_fts(["name"])
table.optimize()
table.disable_fts()

title: core
text:
十四、查找表与多对多

lookup
species_id = db.table("Species").lookup({"name": "Palm"})


extracts — 插入时自动提取
db.table("Trees").insert(
    {"latitude": 49.12, "species": "Common Juniper"},
    extracts={"species": "Species"}
)


m2m — 多对多
dogs.insert({"id": 1, "name": "Cleo"}, pk="id").m2m(
    "humans", {"id": 1, "name": "Natalie"}, pk="id"
)
# 自动创建 dogs_humans 表

# 配合 lookup
dogs.insert({"id": 1, "name": "Cleo"}).m2m(
    "characteristics", lookup={"name": "Playful"}
)

title: core
text:
十六、hash_id 与 conversions
dogs.upsert({"name": "Cleo"}, hash_id="id")      # SHA1 hash 作为 ID
dogs.upsert({"name": "Cleo", "age": 7}, hash_id_columns=("name",))

db.table("example").insert(
    {"name": "foo"},
    conversions={"name": "upper(?)"}             # 插入时 SQL 转换
)

title: core
section: 十七、fastlite vs sqlite-utils 关键差异
text:
十七、fastlite vs sqlite-utils 关键差异

title: core
text:
Symbol Naming
Follow Huffman Coding principle: commonly used things get shorter names.
Life-cycle naming: shorter-lived symbols get shorter names. - Aggressive abbrevs → comprehensions, lambdas, local helpers, temp vars - Common abbrevs → function args, function names, variables - Light/no abbrevs → module names, class names, constructors (they live forever)
Standard Python casing: CamelCase classes, under_score everything else.
Conventions: - o for object in comprehensions, i for index, k/v for dict key/value - x for tensor input (unless library convention differs, e.g. input/target for loss fns) - Use domain abbreviations: sz (size), img (image), lm (language model), nll, kl_divergence - When implementing a paper, follow the paper’s nomenclature: conv1 not first_convolutional_layer

title: core
text:
Layout Rules

Line width: ≤~140 chars.
One line = one idea: put if + its 1-line body on one line using :; never use ; to combine multiple statements.
Ternary operator: x = y if a else b.
Single-line bodies preferred for short with, open, try, except, for, and if statements, plus small one-line functions that don’t need a docstring:

Good: if not data: return None, def _is_ready(self): return self._ready.is_set()
Bad: spreading short bodies across multiple lines

Group similar 1-liners without blank lines between:
def det_lighting(b, c): return lambda x: lighting(x, b, c)
def det_rotate(deg): return lambda x: rotate_cv(x, deg)
def det_zoom(zoom): return lambda x: zoom_cv(x, zoom)
Align conceptually similar parts for visual diffing:
if self.store.stretch_dir==0: x = stretch_cv(x, self.store.stretch, 0)
else:                         x = stretch_cv(x, 0, self.store.stretch)
Destructuring assignment for class members (no spaces after commas, spaces around =):
self.sz,self.denorm,self.norm,self.sz_y = sz,denorm,normalizer,sz_y
Be frugal with vertical whitespace; group imports on one line:
import PIL, os, numpy as np, math, collections, threading

Good: from mymod import (a, b)
Bad: from mymod import a,b

Continuation lines indent 4 spaces beyond the opening block; don’t add extra hanging indent.
Standalone ), ], } attach to the end of the previous content line — not on their own line.
Indent: 4 spaces; no trailing whitespace.
Operator spacing: follow domain notation — no spaces around / in pathlib, math-like spacing in equations.

title: core
text:
Structure

Favor small helpers over repetitive blocks:

Good: def _send_stream(self, name, text): ...; self._send_stream("stdout", out)
Bad: self._send(sock, "stream", {"name": "stdout", "text": out}, parent)

Use comprehensions or inline expressions when they improve clarity:

Good: ids = [m["header"]["msg_id"] for m in msgs]
Bad: ids = []; for m in msgs: ids.append(m["header"]["msg_id"])

title: core
text:
Typing

Never add type annotations to LHS assignments (e.g. x: int = 1), except dataclass fields.
Keep annotations simple; avoid nested generics beyond one level unless you have a strong reason.

title: core
text:
Algorithm Guidelines

Implementation should be at least as fast, accurate, and concise as alternatives. Profile hotspots.
Must scale: work in 16GB RAM on arbitrary datasets → use generators, not lists.
Add equation number comments from paper being implemented.
Use numpy/pytorch broadcasting over loops.
Use advanced indexing over specialized indexing methods.
Test on multiple datasets and compare to existing approaches before PR.

title: core
text:
Documentation

Docs go in docs_src notebooks → generate HTML.
Use brief single-line docstrings for multi-line functions:

Good: def run(self): "Run the thread." ...
Bad: def run(self):\n    """\n    Run the thread.\n    """\n    ...

In code: one-line docstring with back-quoted references to main params.
Style model: Python re module docs.
Use docments (inline # comments in signatures) for parameter docs.
Comments: only explain why, not how. Code should be self-explanatory. Add very few comments.

title: core
text:
Testing

All tests must pass before changes are considered complete.

title: core
text:
Other Rules

Assume latest Python + libs. Note if relying on something < 2 months old.
Link to paper/external doc in code.
import * is fine if using most of a module; use __all__ for internal symbols.
No automatic linters/formatters (autopep8, yapf, etc). Manual layout only.
Keep PRs small; discuss controversial changes on forums first.

When documenting functions, classes, and whatnot, use the docments spec.

title: core
text:
Core Concept
docments lets you document parameters with # comments directly in function signatures, instead of repeating parameter names in numpy/Google-style docstrings:
def add(
    a:int, # the 1st number to add
    b=0,   # the 2nd number to add
)->int:    # the result of adding `a` to `b`
    "The sum of two numbers."
    return a+b
Multi-line comments above a parameter are also supported:
def add(
    # The first operand
    a:int,
    # This is the second operand.
    # Passing negative is equivalent to subtraction.
    b:int,
)->int: # Result
    "Add `a` to `b`"
    return a+b
Works with: functions, async functions, classes (__init__), methods, dataclasses, @delegates, numpy-style docstrings, and mixed styles.

title: core
text:
API Reference

docments(s, full=False, eval_str=False, returns=True, args_kwargs=False) → AttrDict
The primary function. Extracts parameter documentation from s.









Param
Type
Default
Details




s
callable/class
—
Function, class, or method to extract docs from


full
bool
False
If True, values are dicts with keys anno, default, docment. If False, values are just the docment string (or None). When full=True, args_kwargs=True is always set.


eval_str
bool
False
Evaluate stringified annotations (PEP 563 / from __future__ import annotations)


returns
bool
True
Include 'return' key in result


args_kwargs
bool
False
Include *args/**kwargs docs



Returns: AttrDict — keys are param names (+ 'return'), values depend on full.
docments(add)
# {'a': 'the 1st number to add', 'b': 'the 2nd number to add', 'return': 'the result of adding `a` to `b`'}

docments(add, full=True)
# {'a': {'anno': int, 'default': inspect._empty, 'docment': 'the 1st number to add'}, ...}

docments(add, args_kwargs=True)  # includes *args, **kwargs entries
Behaviors: - For classes (non-dataclass): extracts from __init__ - Follows __delwrap__ chain (from @delegates) to collect delegated param docs - Numpy-style docstrings are parsed and merged (inline comments take priority) - Builtins return empty/None values: docments(str) → {'args': None, 'kwargs': None, ...} - Type annotation is inferred from default value when full=True and annotation is missing



docstring(sym) → str|None
Get the docstring for sym (functions and classes).
docstring(add)  # "The sum of two numbers."



parse_docstring(sym) → dict
Parse a numpy-style docstring from sym into a structured dict.



sig_source(obj) → str
Get full source of signature line(s) for a function or class (not the body).
print(sig_source(my_func))
# def my_func(
#     a:int, # first
#     b:str, # second
# )->int:



extract_docstrings(code) → dict
Parse source code string. Returns {name: (docstring, params_str)} for each function/class/method. Private methods (starting with _) are excluded (except __init__, which is folded into the class). Module-level docstring is stored under '_module'.
extract_docstrings("def foo(a, b):\n    'Does foo'\n    ...")
# {'foo': ('Does foo', 'a, b')}



sig2str(func, maxline=110) → str
Generate a formatted function signature string with docments as inline comments. Wraps lines to maxline.
print(sig2str(my_func))
# def my_func(
#     a:int, # first
#     b:str='' # second
# )->int: # result



get_name(obj) → str
Get the name of obj (uses __name__, __qualname__, or type(obj).__name__).


qual_name(obj) → str
Get the qualified name of obj (e.g. 'fastcore.docscrape').


get_source(s) → str
Get source code for string, function object, or dataclass s.


isdataclass(s) → bool
Check if s is a dataclass type (not an instance).


get_dataclass_source(s) → str
Get source code for dataclass s.

title: core
text:
Usage Notes

@delegates support: docments automatically follows the __delwrap__ chain, so delegated params from wrapped functions are included.
Dataclass caveat: If the class was defined in a notebook, docments won’t contain param comments until the notebook is converted to a module (source code unavailable at runtime).
Mixed styles: You can freely mix inline # comments and numpy-style docstring params. Inline comments take priority for any param documented in both places.
All rendering classes inherit from _DocmentBase which calls docments(obj, full=True, eval_str=True) and stores result in self.dm.

Trade-off: @dataclass vs regular class with store_attr()
在 solveit/notebook 环境中，@dataclass 的 docments 注释（# 注释）无法被 docments() 提取，因为 dataclass 在 notebook 里定义时没有源码文件可供解析。docments(MyDataclass) 会返回 None。
解决方案：用普通类 + store_attr() 代替 @dataclass，这样 docments 可以正常工作。
# ❌ Dataclass — docments 在 notebook 里不可用
@dataclass
class Video:
    id:str          # Video ID
    port:int        # SSH Port

# ✅ 普通类 + store_attr — docments 正常工作
class Video:
    def __init__(self,
        id:str,          # Video ID
        port:int,        # SSH Port
    ): store_attr()
用 @docs 装饰器可以给类的方法加 docstring（通过 _docs 字典），但它不影响字段的 docments。
